All four job cards are still open at 0 done: JC-2026-00010 (Form/Brake, BRAKE-02), JC-2026-00011 (Robotic Weld, WELD-03), JC-2026-00012 (Powder Coat, COAT-06).
- **Schedule ceiling:** WS-2026-00001 carries a 480-minute capacity ceiling signal.

- **No cost recorded:** expected_cost and actual_cost are both 0.00, so no variance exists to report.

- Linked sales order **SO-2026-00123**, customer **Cardinal Tillage Works**, delivery date 2026-07-10, value **$80,095.52** — linked directly on this order (recorded exposure). Note it already shows delivered_status "delivered".

- Customer impact: **known** (that one linked order).
